prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1008; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain radiating into the trapezius region, low back pain, and intermittent stiffness with restricted range of motion in both the cervical and lumbar spine. Initial examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness, reduced cervical rotation, and a positive straight leg raise on the left at approximately 45 degrees. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits or reflex changes noted.

Over the course of 20 supervised visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, graduated therapeutic exercise for core and cervical stabilization, and patient education on posture and activity modification. Pain levels were tracked at each visit and showed steady improvement, decreasing from a baseline of 7 out of 10 to 3 out of 10 at discharge. Range of motion in the cervical spine improved to near-functional limits, and the patient reports markedly improved tolerance for sitting and driving.

At discharge, the patient was assessed as having resolving cervical and lumbar strain with residual mild stiffness. A home exercise program was provided, and follow-up care was recommended on an as-needed basis should symptoms recur or worsen.
